2607.03182.title: AnchorVLA: Bridging Discrete Decisions and Continuous Trajectories for Vision-Language-Action Planning
2607.03182.paper_summary: Autonomous driving planning requires translating navigation intent, traffic rules, dynamic interactions, and language instructions into executable continuous trajectories. Vision-Language-Action models have been introduced into driving planning to improve long-tail generalization, commonsense reasoning, high-level semantic understanding, and explainability. However, existing VLA planners mainly follow planning-head-based trajectory prediction or full-trajectory autoregressive generation. The former only weakly constrains continuous trajectory generation with VLA reasoning, while the latter relies on long sequences of low-information-density coordinate tokens, making semantic-action alignment difficult and leading to discretization errors and inefficient inference. To address these limitations, we propose AnchorVLA, a hierarchical decision-anchored VLA planning framework that uses trajectory-pattern anchors as an explicit interface between high-level VLA reasoning and continuous trajectory execution. Specifically, Decision-as-Anchor Representation represents behavior-level driving decisions with anchor tokens, each encoding an entire local motion pattern rather than a single coordinate point. Decision-Anchored Residual Flow then generates fine-grained continuous trajectories in the selected anchor-defined residual space, capturing multi-modal execution refinements after high-level decision making. By reasoning over compact and semantically meaningful anchors instead of autoregressively generating waypoint sequences, AnchorVLA preserves LLM-based decision making while improving inference efficiency, semantic-action alignment, and continuous generation flexibility. Experiments on the Bench2Drive closed-loop benchmark show that AnchorVLA achieves a state-of-the-art Success Rate of 77.28 and a competitive Driving Score of 89.92.
2607.03182.paper_summary_zh: 自主駕駛規劃需要將導航意圖、交通規則、動態互動和語言指令轉換為可執行的連續軌跡。<lb/>視覺-語言-行動模型已被引入駕駛規劃中，以改善長尾泛化、常識推理、高層語義理解和可解釋性。<lb/>然而，現有的 VLA 規劃器主要遵循基於規劃頭的軌跡預測或全軌跡自回歸生成。<lb/>前者僅弱約束連續軌跡生成與 VLA 推理，而後者依賴於低信息密度坐標標記的長序列，這使得語義-行動對齊變得困難，並導致離散化錯誤和低效推理。<lb/>為了解決這些限制，我們提出了 AnchorVLA，一個層次化的決策錨定 VLA 規劃框架，它使用軌跡模式錨作為高層 VLA 推理和連續軌跡執行之間的明確接口。<lb/>具體而言，Decision-as-Anchor Representation 用錨標記表示行為層級的駕駛決策，每個錨標記編碼整個局部運動模式，而不是單一的坐標點。<lb/>Decision-Anchored Residual Flow 然後在選定的錨定義的殘差空間中生成細粒度的連續軌跡，在高層決策後捕捉多模態執行的細化。<lb/>通過在緊湊且語義豐富的錨上進行推理，而不是自回歸生成路徑點序列，AnchorVLA 保留了基於 LLM 的決策制定，同時提高了推理效率、語義-行動對齊和連續生成的靈活性。<lb/>在 Bench2Drive 關閉迴路基準上的實驗顯示，AnchorVLA 實現了 77.28 的最先進成功率和 89.92 的競爭性駕駛分數。
